reason: Item (5) of EO 11248 sec. 1 (level IV) is terminated: EO 11708 sec. 3 revokes EO 11248 as amended 'Except with respect to the positions enumerated in section 2 of this order' (the level V list, which does not include item (5)). The signing date, March 23, 1973 ('The White House, March 23, 1973' at the foot of the order in 38 FR 7980), is the effective date because the order contains no effective-date or delay wording; the date is not taken from any marginal note or computation. Standing placement, not a spent command; no earlier end found: Reorganization Plan No. 2 of 1970 redesignates the Bureau as OMB without abolishing it, and EO 11540's substitution of 'Assistant Director, Office of Management and Budget' (effective 1970-07-01) retitles and widens the item, recorded as a later event. The quote on the end record is the sec. 3 sentence.
